name: CS-H104 11–48T cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 662 g for the CS-H104 10-speed 11–48T ED Black cassette, with steel sprockets; lockring inclusion is assumed under the catalogue guidelines. This is not the lighter CS-G104 alloy-large-cog cassette.
